welcome.title: Welcome to Open Setlist!
welcome.body: Open Setlist is a free, open-source setlist manager that runs entirely in your browser. Your data stays on your device — no account needed.

import.title: Bring Your Songs
import.body: Coming from Setlist Helper? Import your catalog and setlist CSVs on the Sync page. In the song editor, "Paste chart" turns a chart copied from a website or PDF into ChordPro. Create your own profile in Settings first to keep the demo songs apart.

stage.title: On Stage
stage.body: Tap a song in Songs to open it on stage, ✎ at the end of its row opens its editor. On stage, ⋮ → My part shows only your instrument's sections: singers can hide chords, B♭/E♭/F horns read their written pitch. Need paper? Print a stage sheet or a chart booklet from any setlist.

sync.title: Sync with Your Band
sync.body: Connect GitHub or Google Drive on the Sync page, then send your bandmates an invite link. Incoming changes are shown for review before they apply.

install.title: Install the App
install.body: Open Setlist works offline as a PWA. On mobile, use your browser's "Add to Home Screen" option. On desktop, look for the install icon in the address bar.

about.heading: About
about.body:
Open Setlist is a free, open-source setlist manager that runs entirely in your browser.

Your songs and setlists are stored locally on your device. No account is required.

Use profiles to separate different projects or bands. Each profile has its own data and sync configuration.

Connect GitHub or Google Drive on the Sync page to back up and sync across devices. Share your Google Drive file with bandmates to collaborate.

The app works offline as a PWA — use your browser's "Add to Home Screen" to install it.
about.resetMessage: This will delete all local data — profiles, songs, setlists, and preferences. Remote storage (GitHub, Google Drive) will not be affected.

welcome.title: Welcome to Open Setlist
welcome.intro: Three quick choices for this device. You can change them later in Settings.

stageFirst.desc: Tap a song to read it, ✎ to edit it. On stage, ⋮ → Edit this song comes back to the same song after Save.

setlistsAtAGlance.desc: Songs, sets and length (1h42) in the list, ⧉ duplicates. The editor shows what is already in a set, + Add song takes several at once.

songEditor.title: A song editor that shows the chart
songEditor.desc: The chart reads as on stage while you type, Verse, Chorus and Chord buttons write the braces. Leaving unsaved asks first, Cmd/Ctrl+S saves.

tidyCatalog.title: A tidier catalog
tidyCatalog.desc: Tools → Quality unifies names written several ways and cleans Setlist Helper leftovers. Import files sums up what came in and asks before replacing a song you have.

bulkEdit.title: Songs page shortcuts
bulkEdit.desc: Select sets the status or adds a tag to many songs together. Tap an artist or a tag to filter on it, / jumps to the search.
